lines.text: Last one, Mas. What's the best part of the job?

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, answering; the window soft behind him
beats.caption: Mas answers, unhurried. As he starts, a white dot, a HAILSTONE, leaves the lit window and arcs toward us over the bay. We see it; he doesn't.

lines.text: i've gotten to be in the room when we sort of push the veil of ignorance back—and the frontier of discovery forward…

cues: music (v3.2): COLD OPEN · poised, curious · unchanged
one sentence, one read: the take plays on across the next two cuts
the hailstone crosses behind him; no pan splits the sentence

beats.frame: INSERT · the shared table from above: plink
beats.caption: Plink: the hailstone lands in his glass and bobs, glyph noise, no letters. The host's glass sloshes; his doesn't. His phone lies beside it, face-up and dark.
cues: music (v3.2): COLD OPEN · poised, curious · unchanged
cut in on the dash: the plink lands in the read's own phrase break
the tent card reads for the whole insert
the phone is planted here, dark: the freeze lights it

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, the sentence lands
beats.caption: Back on his face for "discovery forward." Far behind him the lit window's phone clicks off; the banquet's applause swells.
cues: music (v3.2): COLD OPEN · poised, curious · unchanged
the same MCU setup as 1.02

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas: he reads it, looks up
beats.caption: He reads it and looks back up. On "noted." his thumb taps Accept below frame, eyes up. The light on his jaw goes pale blue. He sips.

jaw light white -> pale blue at 1.35 s: the only sign he accepted
the clock (Friday, noon) states no outcome

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and the Orb: the iris steps
beats.caption: The Orb's iris steps from the phone to Mas in three drawings. A toast pops beside it, a year under it starting to count back: 2023.
cues: music (v3.2): COLD OPEN · poised, curious · unchanged
the Orb, his witness, carries "how did he get here?" across the cut

beats.frame: WIDE · the room scrubs back, too far: the collapse
beats.caption: The room scrubs back: the ovation sits, the water climbs home, the hailstone flies back. The year catches on 2022 for a second, then slips past, faster; the toast turns to "rewinding… too far" as the wheels spin on toward the nineties. The frame smears and collapses into a cyan cursor on black: the intro's first frame.
cues: music (v3.2): COLD OPEN · poised, curious · unchanged
the counter aims at 2022 (Act One) and overshoots: "too far" lands here; the intro's own 1993 (five seconds on) shows where
